description: This file provides tools for aligning subtitle cues to transcript segments. It includes functions for normalizing data, computing text similarity, pairing cues with transcript segments based on timing and text similarity, and adjusting cues to meet timing, duration, and readability constraints. Its primary purpose is to produce synchronized, high-quality subtitle timings aligned with a given transcript, without performing any I/O operations.

methods.description: Aligns subtitle cues to a transcript based on timing and text similarity, adjusting timings and text formatting to produce a consistent subtitle track.
